acceptance_conditions.condition: Research questions, hypotheses and falsifiers are explicit before June SRFD result exposure.
Representation, segmentation, distance, family-method and parameter/sensitivity candidate grid is exact and predeclared.
Strong-family, invariant-core, ambiguity and residual rules are exact, non-composite and selected only from pre-run design/synthetic criteria.
Eligible-population binding procedure is frozen without adopting the historical 8598 reference as the final population.
Failure-attribution precedence, required output tables, stop conditions and run-manifest template are explicit.
Preregistration has exact byte and canonical logical SHA-256 identities.
T0 limits and dependency state are exact; no new dependency was admitted.
June execution/provider fetch and Validation access remain denied.
Scientific promotion, selector, publication, probability, risk, exposure and execution authority remain none.
Repository suite, FINAL_HEAD profile assurance and merge-readiness checks pass on the implementation candidate.

rollback: Before operator acknowledgement, supersede the candidate only with a versioned WP9 preregistration candidate and rerun complete QA. Do not inspect June SRFD benchmark results to choose replacement rules.
warnings: The historical 8598 C2-state count remains NON_BINDING_CAPACITY_AND_COVERAGE_REFERENCE_ONLY; exact eligible population and source release are intentionally deferred to SRFDI-G-JUNE-AUTH.
The radius/support/PAM ladders and strong-family rule were frozen from pre-run design criteria and synthetic capacity anchors, not from June SRFD results.
The strong-family rule is intentionally strict; NO_STABLE_FAMILY and METHOD_DEPENDENT_STRUCTURE remain lawful results.
HDBSCAN, OPTICS and MATRIX_PROFILE remain disabled conditional methods and are not silently omitted from the dependency ledger.
